D: Five years on, the Ghostbusters find a river of pink slime under New York.
P: Bring dessert out when the Statue of Liberty starts walking.
S: beetroot and feta, flatbread for scooping
Roast beetroot, blitz with feta, Greek yoghurt, garlic, lemon and dill until hot pink. Warm flatbread.
the slime makes the toaster dance
Toast crumpets until the holes are crisp, brush with butter whipped with honey and a pinch of salt, cut into quarters.
Mini bagel pizzas with hot salami
fuel for Dana's long days restoring paintings at the museum

Toasted mini bagels with oregano tomato sauce, hot salami and bubbling mozzarella, baked crisp and finished with chilli honey. Halve 8 mini bagels and toast lightly. Mix 150g passata with 1 tsp dried oregano and a pinch of salt and spread over the cut sides. Top with 100g sliced hot salami and 150g grated mozzarella. Bake at 220C for 8 to 10 minutes until bubbling and the edges are crisp. Warm 2 tbsp honey with a pinch of chilli flakes and drizzle over before serving.
M: Liberty hot dogs with green relish
for the walk up Fifth Avenue behind the Statue of Liberty

Griddled franks in steamed buns with mustard, bright green pickle relish, diced onion and a hot sauerkraut topping. Simmer 8 franks in water for 5 minutes, then griddle on a hot pan for 3 minutes until blistered. Finely chop 2 dill pickles and half a green capsicum, mix with 1 tbsp sugar and 1 tbsp white vinegar for the relish. Warm 200g sauerkraut in a small pan. Steam 8 hot dog buns over the frank water for 1 minute. Fill with franks, mustard, relish, diced onion and sauerkraut.
slow paprika beef for the Carpathian painting
Chuck browned, onions cooked down, sweet and hot paprika, caraway, tomato and stock, braised 2.5 hours. Sour cream and egg noodles.
W: it wobbles and reacts to music
Pink lemonade set with gelatine (4 leaves per 500ml) in a jelly mould. Play something upbeat while you turn it out.
K: Pink lemonade over ice with a scoop of raspberry sorbet.

steps.text: Wrap the beetroots in foil.
Roast at 200C until tender, then cool a little and peel.
Blitz the beetroot with the feta, yoghurt, garlic, lemon juice and a little dill until bright pink and smooth. Warm the flatbreads, cut into wedges and serve for scooping.

dishes.make_ahead: Honey butter up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Beat the butter with the honey and salt.
Toast the crumpets until the holes are crisp.
Spread with the honey butter while hot so it runs into the holes, then cut into quarters.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in a hot pan with oil.
Cook the onions slowly in the same pot until soft.
Stir in the sweet paprika, hot paprika and caraway, then add the tomatoes, stock and beef.
Cover and braise at 160C until the beef is very tender.
Boil the noodles and serve the goulash over them with the sour cream.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in a hot pan with oil.
Cook the onions slowly in the same pot until soft.
Stir in the sweet paprika, hot paprika and caraway, then add the tomatoes, stock, potatoes, capsicum and mushrooms.
Cover and simmer gently until the potatoes are very tender and the sauce is thick.
Boil the noodles and serve the goulash over them with the sour cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the day before, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the gelatine leaves in cold water.
Warm part of the lemonade, squeeze the gelatine and stir in until melted, then add the rest of the lemonade.
Pour into a jelly mould with the raspberries.
Chill in the fridge until set.
Dip the mould in hot water, turn out and put on something upbeat.

veg.make_ahead: Make the day before, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the agar into 250ml of the lemonade in a saucepan and leave for 5 minutes.
Bring to the boil, stirring, and simmer for 2 minutes, then take off the heat and stir in the rest of the lemonade.
Pour into a jelly mould with the raspberries.
Chill in the fridge until set, about 2 hours.
Dip the mould in hot water, turn out and put on something upbeat.
Put a scoop of raspberry sorbet in each of four tall glasses.
Pour chilled pink lemonade slowly over the top so it fizzes up pink. Serve with a spoon and a straw.

veg: Slow paprika beef, onions, caraway and tomato. Egg noodles, sour cream.
Paprika mushrooms, onions, caraway and tomato. Egg noodles, sour cream.

s.note: beetroot and feta, flatbread for scooping
s.how: Wrap 2 beetroots in foil and roast at 200C for 1 hour, then peel. Blitz with 100g feta, 150g Greek yoghurt, 1 garlic clove, the juice of half a lemon and a little dill until bright pink and smooth. Serve with 4 warm flatbreads cut into wedges.

s.note: the slime makes the toaster dance
s.how: Beat 60g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of salt. Toast 8 crumpets until the holes are crisp, spread with the honey butter while hot so it runs into the holes, and cut into quarters.

m.note: slow paprika beef for the Carpathian painting
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Cook 3 sliced brown onions slowly for 20 minutes, add 2 tbsp sweet paprika, a pinch of hot paprika and 1 tsp caraway seeds, then 400g crushed tomatoes, 300ml beef stock and the beef. Braise at 160C for 2.5 hours. Serve over 400g egg noodles with 150g sour cream.

w.note: it wobbles and reacts to music
w.how: Soak 8 gelatine leaves in cold water. Warm 300ml of 1 litre pink lemonade, squeeze the gelatine and stir in until melted, then add the rest of the lemonade. Pour into a jelly mould with 125g raspberries and set 6 hours. Dip in hot water, turn out and put on something upbeat.

d.how: Put a scoop of raspberry sorbet in each of four tall glasses, about 400ml in total. Pour chilled pink lemonade slowly over the top, about 250ml a glass, so it fizzes up pink. Serve with a spoon and a straw.
